content: {"episode_id":"ep-05007","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for missing prior authorization based on the documented clinical indication. The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness, which the clinical indication note describes as clinically consistent with underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered for continuous ambulatory assessment to evaluate the correlation between these symptoms and potential arrhythmic events."}
